description: Historical exchange-rate series for any ECB currency pair over the last N days: start/end rates, high, low, average and percentage change, plus the daily table. The auditable answer to 'how did EUR/USD move this month' for reports and pricing decisions. Use this when an agent needs to time series of a currency pair from ECB data. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
